events.title: Rhaenyra named heir
events.description: King Viserys I names his daughter Rhaenyra as his successor — an unprecedented choice in the patriarchal world of Westeros. This decision sows the seeds of the Dance of the Dragons.

events.title: Daemon exiled: Heir for a Day
events.description: Daemon Targaryen falls from favour after his mocking remark about Rhaenyra as 'heir for a day'. Viserys exiles his brother, who subsequently goes to conquer the Stepstones.

events.title: Rhaenyra weds Laenor Velaryon
events.description: To forge political ties, Rhaenyra weds Laenor Velaryon, heir of House Velaryon. The marriage strengthens the alliance between the Targaryens and the wealthiest naval fleet in Westeros.

events.title: Alicent Hightower weds Viserys I
events.description: Viserys I remarries the young Alicent Hightower — Rhaenyra's closest friend — at the behest of the cunning Hand of the King, Otto Hightower. Rhaenyra feels deeply betrayed.

events.title: Aemond claims Vhagar
events.description: After the death of Laena Velaryon, young Aemond Targaryen sneaks up to the largest living dragon Vhagar at night and tames her. The incident erupts into a fight in which Aemond loses an eye.

events.title: Fire at Harrenhal — the Strong family perishes
events.description: Lord Lyonel Strong and his son Harwin — Rhaenyra's loyal protector — die in a suspicious fire at Harrenhal. The scheming Larys Strong set the fire as a service to Alicent Hightower.

events.title: Rhaenyra and Daemon wed
events.description: After the deaths of their respective spouses, Rhaenyra and her uncle Daemon wed on Driftmark. The two factions — the Blacks and the Greens — are definitively formed.

events.title: Viserys I dies — the Dance begins
events.description: King Viserys I dies after a prolonged illness. Alicent misinterprets his last words as a wish for Aegon II as successor, whereupon the Greens act swiftly and crown Aegon II — the war erupts.

events.title: Blood and Cheese
events.description: As revenge for the death of Lucerys Velaryon, Daemon and Rhaenyra send assassins to the Red Keep. They break into Helaena's bedroom and murder her young son Jaehaerys.

events.title: Battle of Rook's Rest
events.description: Aemond lures Rhaenys and her dragon Meleys into an ambush above Rook's Rest. Rhaenys and Meleys die heroically; Aegon II's dragon Sunfyre is also badly wounded.

events.title: Battle of the Gullet
events.description: A massive naval battle in the Narrow Sea in which three wild dragons are deployed by the Blacks. Both sides suffer enormous losses, but the Blacks regain control of access to Blackwater Bay.

events.title: Rhaenyra conquers King's Landing
events.description: Rhaenyra manages to occupy King's Landing and proclaims herself queen. Her rule over the capital is brief, however, as the city's population soon turns against her.

events.title: Dragonpit riot — Syrax dies
events.description: The people of King's Landing rise up and storm the Dragonpit. Several dragons are killed by the rioting mob, including Rhaenyra's own dragon Syrax.

events.title: Rhaenyra dies — captured by Aegon II
events.description: Rhaenyra flees King's Landing but is captured by Aegon II, who has her devoured by his badly wounded dragon Sunfyre. The rightful heir is dead.

events.title: Aegon II dies — Aegon III becomes king
events.description: Aegon II survives his rival by only a few months. He himself dies, and his nephew Aegon III (Rhaenyra's son) becomes the new king of Westeros — the Dance is over.

events.title: ~170 years pass — The dragons die out
events.description: Under Aegon III the last Targaryen dragons die one by one. They come to be regarded increasingly as legendary creatures, until they disappear entirely from history.

events.title: Jon Arryn dies — Ned Stark summoned
events.description: Hand of the King Jon Arryn dies under suspicious circumstances. King Robert Baratheon asks his old friend Ned Stark to take over the role — and with that, the tragedy of House Stark begins.

events.title: Ned discovers Cersei's secret
events.description: In King's Landing, Ned discovers that Jon Arryn was murdered because he had uncovered the true parentage of Cersei's children — they are not Robert's, but children of Cersei and her brother Jaime.

events.title: Daenerys weds Khal Drogo
events.description: Daenerys Targaryen is wed at her brother Viserys's insistence to Dothraki warlord Khal Drogo. On the steppe she discovers her inner strength and authority as khaleesi.

events.title: Ned Stark executed
events.description: Ned Stark is arrested for treason and, although he confesses guilt in exchange for mercy, the young Joffrey has him executed regardless — an unexpected blow to all who thought they were following the hero.

events.title: Daenerys's dragons hatched
events.description: After Khal Drogo's death, Daenerys steps into his burning funeral pyre. The next morning she emerges unharmed with three newly hatched dragons — for the first time in nearly 170 years.

events.title: The Red Wedding
events.description: During his uncle's wedding, the Freys and Boltons strike: Robb Stark, his pregnant wife Talisa, and his mother Catelyn are all murdered — one of the most traumatic television events of all time.

events.title: Joffrey poisoned
events.description: Joffrey Baratheon is poisoned at his own wedding feast. Tyrion Lannister is wrongfully accused; he flees after killing his father Tywin and goes to Essos to serve Daenerys.

events.title: Jon Snow's first death
events.description: After a controversial alliance with the Wildlings, Jon Snow is stabbed by his own Night's Watch brothers and left for dead in the snow. The Night's Watch regards him as a traitor.

events.title: Jon Snow resurrected — his true lineage revealed
events.description: Melisandre resurrects Jon Snow. Bran reveals through a vision that Jon is the secret son of Lyanna Stark and Rhaegar Targaryen — and therefore the rightful heir to the Iron Throne.

events.title: Recapture of Winterfell
events.description: Jon and Sansa retake Winterfell in the Battle of the Bastards, saved at the last moment by the knights of the Vale. Ramsay Bolton, the sadistic ruler, is fed to his own starving hounds by Sansa.

events.title: Cersei crowns herself queen
events.description: Cersei blows up the Sept of Baelor with wildfire, killing hundreds. After her son Tommen's suicide, she crowns herself Queen of the Seven Kingdoms.

events.title: Daenerys lands in Westeros
events.description: Daenerys finally arrives on Dragonstone with her three dragons, Dothraki, and Unsullied. She meets Jon Snow and they fight side by side, but her true nature continues to reveal itself.

events.title: Night King kills Viserion — The Wall falls
events.description: Beyond The Wall, the Night King hurls an ice spear and kills Daenerys's dragon Viserion. He raises the dragon as an ice dragon, which helps destroy The Wall — a thousand years of protection falls.

events.title: Arya kills the Night King
events.description: In the Battle of Winterfell, Arya Stark sneaks up behind the Night King and kills him with the Valyrian steel dagger. The entire army of the dead collapses in an instant.

events.title: Burning of King's Landing
events.description: Daenerys burns King's Landing and thousands of innocent civilians. Jon Snow kills her to prevent further slaughter; Drogon melts the Iron Throne and flies away. Bran Stark is chosen as the new king.
